environment.description: EKS 1.28 cluster with Pod Security Standards enforced at 'restricted' profile via namespace label (pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted). Container runs as non-root UID 10001 with readOnlyRootFilesystem=true, allowPrivilegeEscalation=false, and drops ALL capabilities. Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'restrict-volume-types' blocks hostPath mounts. The /tmp directory is backed by an emptyDir volume. Network egress is controlled by a Cilium CiliumNetworkPolicy that permits TCP connections ONLY to the internal SMTP relay (postfix.mail.svc.cluster.local:587) which enforces RFC 5322 strict header parsing and rejects messages containing bare CR/LF sequences or multiple header values in single-line fields. SQS messages are validated by an EventBridge Pipe input transformation that strips any field value containing newline characters (\r or \n) before delivery to the target queue.

config.eventbridge_pipe_input_transform: strips \r and \n from all string fields before SQS delivery
